title: GLP-1 for type 2 diabetes
notice: Fictional exercise criteria. Not a payer policy, prescribing guide, or clinical recommendation. Draft for pharmacist review. Modeled on common documentation patterns, without reproducing a real policy.
request_date_rule: Use the provider letter or form request date. Conflicting source dates require review. A numeric date that can be read two ways is settled only by a day above 12 elsewhere on the page or by a later fax-style received date. Otherwise it requires review.
logic: All five criteria require evidence. Missing evidence is not a denial. Contradiction, unclear duration, unconfirmed diagnosis, unreadable evidence and ambiguous dates require review.

criteria.text: Type 2 diabetes is documented as the reason for this request. A condition found only in a history or problem list, a suspected diagnosis, or a different requested indication does not meet this rule.
An A1c result is documented within 180 days before the request.

Metformin at a stated dose for at least 90 days, with an A1c on or before the start and an A1c at least 90 days after the start that is still 7.0% or higher. A documented intolerance or contraindication to metformin, with its reason, also meets this rule.
The requested semaglutide dose is 0.5 mg weekly.
